question.value: Can a photo-ionized disk survive around G345.49+1.47 and sustain continued accretion?

evidence.quote: the data present direct observational evidence of how disks can effectively survive the photo-ionization feedback from young high-mass stars.
Can the disk around G345.49+1.47 sustain these accretion rates?

Observations of G345.49+1.47 were taken using the ALMA Band 6
We focus our analysis on the 1875 MHz wide SpW centered at 222.75 GHz ($\sim1.3$ mm).
